shortcut.title: Set up Mac shortcut
shortcut.intro: Press a key combination on your Mac to take a note while the video keeps its focus. You set this up once.
shortcut.step1: Create your shortcut key here. It can only take notes in your own running recording.
shortcut.replaceHelp: The current key (ending in {{hint}}) stops working.
shortcut.keyShownOnce: Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
shortcut.activeKey: A key ending in {{hint}} is active.
shortcut.step2: Open the Shortcuts app and create a shortcut named "Take note" with these actions:
shortcut.action1: Current Date, then Format Date with the custom format yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. This marks the press, so a repeat never takes a second note.
shortcut.action2: Get Contents of URL. Method: POST.
shortcut.action2Header2: Header X-Invocation-Id: the Formatted Date from the first action
shortcut.action3: Show Notification with the Contents of URL. It tells you what happened.
shortcut.step3: In the shortcut's details (ⓘ), choose Add Keyboard Shortcut and press a free combination, for example Control–Option–N.
shortcut.step4: Test it. Create a second shortcut that posts to the test address with the same Authorization header, or use the button below.
shortcut.testNeedsKey: The key is only known right after it is created. Create a new key to test from here, or run the test shortcut on your Mac.
shortcut.curlHelp: Use the action Run Shell Script with this command instead:
shortcut.hintHelp: Shown next to the Take note button. Only stored in this browser.
shortcut.lastDelay: Last shortcut press: {{ms}} ms from key to frame.
